text_to_speech: Carrie a delawarean who's married to an active duty member of our Armed Forces sent me a note on Facebook wondering what kinds of concrete actions are being taken to help veterans and their families find jobs after they complete their service well car I was a co-sponsor of Senator Patty Murray's hiring America's Heroes act last year which ultimately um passed the Senate unanimously in something called The Vow to hire Heroes act and it strengthened the transition assistance program strengthened the investment in making sure that those who serve our nation are also getting skills that translate to the civilian world I'm also partnering with Wilmington University on a jobs Fair specifically focused on Veterans on Saturday April 21st and I worked with Senator Casey of Pennsylvania on a bill that specifically targets helping returning veterans get new franchises by giving them $25 ,000 tax exemption if they take their resources and start a new franchise those are just a few of the things that I and many others in Congress have been trying to do I'd certainly welcome more advice and input and certainly my constituent case workers are always available uh to anyone who's looking for help who's transitioning back from serving our nation thanks for your message k
